entries.note: The sender's order, booked on the website under WEB STATION before the parcel is handed over.
Arrived at the shop that collects it from the sender.

entries.wording: ΠΑΡΑΛΑΒΗ ΟΛΩΝ ΤΩΝ ΤΕΜΑΧΙΩΝ ΤΗΣ ΑΠΟΣΤΟΛΗΣ ΣΤΟ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΗΜΑ ΠΑΡΑΛΑΒΗΣ
entries.note: All pieces received at the collecting shop. Newer pages print it in sentence case followed by the shop's name.

entries.wording: Παραλαβή όλων των τεμαχίων της αποστολής στο κατάστημα παραλαβής: …
entries.note: All pieces received at the shop named after the colon. The delivery station can repeat it on the day of delivery.
The parcel was collected; the tracking page's own script hides it and dates its collection step by it.

entries.wording: Το τεμάχιο Νο: […] εντάχθηκε στο σάκο
entries.note: A piece put in a bag at a branch or hub. Also written "Το τεμάχιο Νο. … εντάχθηκε στον σάκο".
Left a branch or hub. Written "Αναχώρηση Από κατάστημα" when the hub hands the parcel to ELTA.

entries.wording: Η ΑΠΟΣΤΟΛΗ ΑΝΑΧΩΡΗΣΕ ΑΠΟ ΤΟ ΣΤΑΘΜΟ

entries.note: A piece arrived at a branch or hub. Also written with "Νο.", and at the delivery station followed by " παραλαβής: " and its name.
A piece arrived at the delivery station named after it.
Arrived at the delivery station; the capture shows it for an intermediate station too.
On its way; named in the tracking page's own script, which hides it.

entries.wording: Ανάθεση προς διαχείριση στο δίκτυο της EASYMAIL
entries.note: Handed to the partner network EASYMAIL; named in the tracking page's own script.

entries.wording: Ανάθεση αποστολής για παράδοση σε διανομέα
entries.note: Given to a courier for delivery. The page shows it as "Η παραγγελία σας είναι καθ’ οδόν για παράδοση".
The tracking page's own script looks for this scan to strip the notice number that follows it.
Followed by who took the parcel, masked, and the date and time, which the adapter drops.
Delivered by the courier.

entries.wording: Η αποστολή έχει αφιχθεί στο δίκτυο της Box Now και βρίσκεται σε διακίνηση προς την θυρίδα
entries.note: BOX NOW's leg: in its network on the way to the locker, at the times BOX NOW records in-depot scans.

entries.wording: Η αποστολή έχει αφιχθεί στην θυρίδα Box Now
entries.note: BOX NOW's leg: in the locker, when BOX NOW records it at its final destination.
BOX NOW's leg: collected from the locker, when BOX NOW records it delivered.
ELTA's leg: arrived at one of its sorting or delivery offices, as ELTA's own tracker shows it.
ELTA's leg: sent on from an office; ELTA's English tracker says "Shipment in transit".
ELTA's leg: ELTA's English tracker says "Item delivered".

entries.wording: ΑΠΟΣΤΟΛΗ ΕΝΗΜΕΡΩΣΗΣ ΠΑΡΑΛΗΠΤΗ ΣΤΟ ΤΗΛΕΦΩΝΟ: […] ΜΕ ΘΕΜΑ: […]
entries.note: A message to the recipient: the masked phone, then its subject, which the adapter keeps as the wording without a link it carries.

entries.wording: Εστάλη μήνυμα ενημέρωσης για σημερινή παράδοση της αποστολής
entries.note: A message to the recipient that the parcel comes today, after it is given to a courier; not a movement.

entries.wording: Εστάλη μήνυμα για την δυνατότητα αναδρομολόγησης σε Clever Point
entries.note: A message offering to reroute the parcel to a Clever Point locker; not a movement.
A call to the recipient; named in the tracking page's own script, which hides it.
The recipient's instruction to collect the parcel at the delivery station, given through Courier Center's assistant; the page's script moves its place to that station. Not the collection itself.
The recipient's request to collect the parcel at a shop; named in the tracking page's own script, which hides it.
A payment link for the recipient; named in the tracking page's own script, which hides it.
The overall status the result page shows above the history, as "(29) DeliveryCompleted".
The overall status the result page shows above the history, as "(18) BagAssigned": a piece was put in a bag.
An overall status the tracking page's own script reads as the parcel waiting at a Clever Point.
An overall status the tracking page's own script ends the journey with, as compensated.
An overall status the tracking page's own script shows as a compensation under way. Its number is not known.
An overall status the tracking page's own script ends the journey with, as returned to the sender. Its number is not known.
An overall status the tracking page's own script replaces with "Ο ΠΡΟΜΗΘΕΥΤΗΣ ΣΑΣ ΔΕΝ ΜΑΣ ΕΧΕΙ ΠΑΡΑΔΩΣΕΙ ΑΚΟΜΗ ΤΟ ΔΕΜΑ", the sender not having handed the parcel over yet, hiding the history.
